claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings provide three validated complementary modes at maximum evaluated scale (24yr/158k): (1) citation heritage recovery AUC 0.767-0.770 > 0.75, (2) section cross-lingual alignment for facts/holdings but not reasoning, (3) linear hybrid complement passing adversarial gates at w=0.3-0.4 but remaining below TF-IDF baseline on jurist preference. No single representation dominates all metrics. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES pending corpus completion. Audit repairs 1-3 from CYCLE_37239653489 verified and applied.
evidence_summary: Total evidence files verified: 17/17 evidence_refs + 4 supplementary + 2 repair artifacts. Citation heritage: 3 scales (21yr, 22yr, 24yr) — all PASS for center_projected (AUC 0.818, 0.792, 0.767). Section cross-lingual: 3 sections at 1K sample — Sachverhalt/Dispositiv PASS, Erwaegungen FAIL. Linear hybrids: Weight sweep at 22yr — PASS at w=0.3-0.4 for both adversarial gates (JP 0.61-0.67, LangDom 0.65-0.75) but below TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.78-0.79). Adversarial suite: 4 dense variants at 22yr — all FAIL jurist gate, PASS language dominance (CP only). Legal TF-IDF bge_: 8 variants — all FAIL citation heritage, branch kNN, multilingual invariance. v18 hierarchy: FAIL at 4-label branch level (purity 0.65 < 0.7). Checkpoints: 24 years of embeddings (2000-2023) exist; 2024-2026 missing. Progress.json: Accurate except 2021-2023 false 'failed' flags (embeddings valid). Repair artifacts: comprehensive_validation_all_results.json (v5 baseline JP=0.4892), citation_role_integration_all_results.json (base roles FAIL_DEGENERATE, alpha-blended PASS). Negative results honestly represented as first-class evidence. No leakage, weak baselines, benchmark gaming, or boilerplate confounding detected. All claims in legal-distance.json are evidence-backed and accurately reported. Repairs from prior audit cycle fully verified.
